AcceptanceGates.Name: Core startup & lifecycle
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Non-elevated core without mandatory driver/service/Explorer injection, session-scoped singleton, safe shutdown
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Session-scoped singleton mutex and dynamic Explorer recovery verified; automated guest qualification harness active in PR #67. Clean shutdown under WM_ENDSESSION in clean disposable VM remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Windows compatibility
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Required Windows 10/11 x64 matrix; honest fallback on unsupported effects
AcceptanceGates.Reason: 7-tier OS matrix specified in PRD Section 2.1, registry UBR detection and PerMonitorV2 dynamic scaling verified; automated compatibility audit tool active. Live VM matrix tests across all 7 OS builds remain outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Shell isolation
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: All stable binaries and packages contain no Explorer extension; no hooks into critical protected processes
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Non-injection architecture verified; package artifact isolation auditor (scripts/audit_package_artifacts.ps1) and regression suite verify 0 Explorer extensions across packages. Live disposable VM module audit remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Taskbar recovery
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: External effects gated; native fallback; no repeated fighting or Explorer loop
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Non-invasive conflict detection yields to third-party customizers; TaskbarCreated recovery handles Explorer restart with debounce protection; automated guest harness verified in PR #67. Live VM pixel capture remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Experimental qualification
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Any opt-in Explorer extension: disposable-VM tests, then dedicated recoverable hardware qualification before limited experimental distribution (not stable gate if absent)
AcceptanceGates.Evidence: PRD Section 18.2, Owner Decisions Q02:C, Q35:B
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Stable core contains zero in-process Explorer extensions, XAML bridge DLLs, or injection hooks. Marked NOT_APPLICABLE per PRD Section 18.2 note ('not stable gate if absent').

AcceptanceGates.Name: Desktop layering
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Wallpaper below passive widgets below desktop icons on qualifying builds; otherwise visibly unsupported/disabled
AcceptanceGates.Reason: DesktopHostWindow positions overlay behind desktop icons; Win32 RegisterShellHookWindow automatically re-asserts stacking behind icons on Win+D shell messages; automated guest harness active. Visual icon lasso test in VM remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Temporary Interactive Mode
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Tray/hotkey opens bounded overlay, user action works; Escape/timeout/focus change restores passive icon input
AcceptanceGates.Reason: InteractionController implements 4 auto-dismissal triggers (Escape, 8s timeout, focus change, session lock); spatial pointer hit-testing and global hotkey Win+Ctrl+A verified; automated guest harness active in PR #67. VM focus video remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Sensor honesty
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Missing counters collapse/show unknown; optional external providers; tested non-waking sampling
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Native Win32 telemetry providers report hardware metrics honestly (GPU omitted honestly per PRD F22); 1s non-waking battery sampling enforced. Battery and AC power state matrix verification across target hardware remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Local adaptive audio
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Default-on local WASAPI, endpoint recovery, battery 15 FPS default, AC 30 FPS, configurable 60 FPS, no persistent samples
AcceptanceGates.Reason: WASAPI shared-loopback capture thread computes 512-point FFT strictly in memory without disk persistence; IMMNotificationClient handles dynamic device migration; presentation loop throttles framerate. Device disconnect/reconnect in VM remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Lua worker reliability and trust
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Script host separate and lazy; explicit digest-bound consent; crash/hang detected without core-blocking; IPC invalid payload rejected
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Supervised child worker runs in 128 MB Job Object with CREATE_SUSPENDED containment; pure-Rust SHA-256 pre-execution digest trust and continuous runtime watchdog revalidation; automated fault injection harness in PR #67. VM fault injection remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: WinUI Settings independence
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: C++/WinRT process on-demand, exits on close, survives lost IPC, core survives crash
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Native C++/WinRT executable (aethershell-settings.exe) exits cleanly on close; authenticated Named Pipe IPC client with strict JSON schema parsing; automated crash isolation harness in PR #67. Live VM streaming fault injection remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Schema/backup
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: All TOML samples parse; migrations reversible; installed and portable share intended AppData store with conflict protection
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Bidirectional reversible migrations (1.0.0 <-> 1.1.0 <-> 2.0.0) with pre-migration backup (.bak) and Win32 exclusive file-locking guard (ConfigLockGuard); multi-process concurrency suite (tests/config_concurrency_tests.ps1) verified. Multi-instance VM concurrency remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Performance
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Real measured workloads meet ratified budgets on baseline matrix; no false exact-zero claims
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Genuine multi-process runtime benchmark procedure; empirical bare-metal AMD Ryzen 5 5500U baseline ratified under PRD Section 14.4 (Private Commit 25.2 MB passes <= 30 MB budget; WorkingSet 43.8 MB median ratified); active Win32 trim_working_set() wired to idle presentation loop. Multi-monitor VM driver tiers remain outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Accessibility
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Keyboard, Narrator/UIA, high contrast, scaling, reduced motion, localized truncation rules
AcceptanceGates.Reason: InteractiveRegion accessible metadata, Win32 NotifyWinEvent focus/activation dispatches, native COM UI Automation provider hierarchy (WM_GETOBJECT returning IRawElementProviderSimple/Fragment), and automated UIA reflection test suite (tests/accessibility_uia_tests.ps1). Live Narrator speech audit in VM remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Five-channel release
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: MSI, MSIX, Microsoft Store approved listing, WinGet, self-contained portable fully qualified; no partial stable release (Q40:A)
AcceptanceGates.Evidence: EVD-047, Owner Decisions Q40:A, Q42:A, Q46:B
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Multi-channel packaging automation (scripts/build_packages.ps1) verified for release compilation with path remapping, WinUI 3 runtime staging, self-contained portable ZIP assembly, and SHA-256 manifests. Public distribution, Store submission, and WinGet publication remain intentionally DEFERRED per Q40:A until full stability is verified.

AcceptanceGates.Name: License/privacy
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Apache-2.0 LICENSE and dependency notices; no unsolicited analytics or raw audio upload
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Apache-2.0 LICENSE, third-party dependency attribution notice, machine-readable SPDX-2.3 SBOM with NOASSERTION concluded licenses, compiler path remapping, packet-level zero-leakage auditor (25ms NDIS iphlpapi scanning + DNS differential), and automated guest network audit verified in PR #67. Live VM network packet trace remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Safe Mode and recovery
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Restart safe mode, widget/worker quarantine, Explorer cleanup, rollback, IPC errors, update recovery
AcceptanceGates.Reason: --safe-mode CLI argument forces NativeNoopBackend and bypasses shell hooks; Lua worker quarantine circuit breaker; DXGI device loss exponential backoff recovery; config self-healing from .bak; automated guest harness verified in PR #67. Update rollback in VM remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Strict no-go and evidence
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: No unverified critical behavior represented as supported; no physical-host disruptive tests; all gates signed off
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Premature release v1.0.0 withdrawn (Q42:A, Q45:B); Q37:A safety constraints strictly observed; all 20 gates truthfully classified; release disposition NO-GO; CORE_STABLE_CANDIDATE strictly not declared; formal release acceptance ledger generated. Dedicated multi-OS physical/VM qualification records remain outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Coexistence
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Detected competing taskbar style controller yields; does not terminate or modify third-party process
AcceptanceGates.Reason: detect_taskbar_conflicts() inspects running processes and deterministically yields to NativeNoopBackend without terminating third-party processes; automated guest coexistence test verified in PR #67. Live coexistence observation alongside actively running utilities in disposable VM remains outstanding.

AcceptanceGates.Name: Packaging identity
AcceptanceGates.PassCondition: Same user data semantics across MSI/MSIX/Store/portable, startup toggles, signed migrators and rollback
AcceptanceGates.Reason: Canonical data path resolution implemented in crates/aethershell-config/src/storage.rs targeting %LOCALAPPDATA%\AetherShell across all channels per PRD Q38:B; automated identity continuity suite (tests/packaging_identity_continuity_tests.ps1, 4/4 passed) proves portable builds resolve canonical AppData and reject local portable markers. Clean-OS VM cross-channel migration suite remains outstanding.
